title: SimpleHeal
description: Heal your self or other player
body:
# SimpleHeal

**Provides the /heal command for fully restoring health and saturation, and removing fire effects. The plugin supports configurable healing amount (heal-amount), a global cooldown (cooldown-seconds), and granular permissions for self-healing and healing others (permission, Permission-others). Server admins can control whether players are allowed to heal others using allow-heal-others; additionally, all actions are secured through permission checks and sensible limits, ensuring that heals never exceed a player's maximum health.**

## Commands

- **/heal**  -heal your self

- **/heal (player)** -heal other players

## Permissions

- **healplugin.heal** Allows you to use /heal 

- **healplugin.heal.others** -Allows you to use /heal (player)
